title: Enter disconnection and confirm disconnection order
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM
If notification is required, the system generates a notification work item . The CRM agent assigned to this work item must contact
the customer, set an agreed date and close the work item before the disconnection order can be processed further.

If notification is not required, or if the notification work item is closed, you can continue processing the disconnection order.

During generation of a disconnection order, you can also create a corresponding service order in service management (SM) and
continue processing it there. The service order is used for example, as a work instruction for a field service employee. Note
however, that if notification is required, the system can only generate service orders after you have set the agreed date and the
notification work item is closed.

Enter disconnection and confirm disconnection order

In this step, you enter when and how which devices and flat-rate installations were disconnected. If the disconnections were
planned in the processing variant you can carry out the following additional activities:

Generate a customer contact.

Change the budget billing plan or induce a budget billing stop — the budget billing stop is automatically reset when you enter the
reconnection.

Enter a meter reading for a disconnected meter — you can create a billing order with the billing transaction Interim billing for the
affected devices.

If you are working in an Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) environment, you can configure the system to automatically
trigger a meter reading from an AMI device (for example an advanced meter or smart meter).

Post a disconnection charge — in order to post disconnection charges, you must maintain the corresponding charges schema in
Customizing by choosing Contract accounts receivable and payable (FI-CA) — Accounting transaction — Dunning.

The disconnection charges are posted based on the contracts.

You can set the confirmation status in Customizing. Statuses must be defined for the entry of either disconnections or
reconnections.

You can disconnect both metering and non-metering devices, provided you have activated the functions in Customizing

accordingly.

You can remove disconnected devices, or devices contained in a disconnection order. A removed device is indicated in a
disconnection document using the status Removed or Removed and Disconnected . A removed device is no longer available for
the subsequent disconnection actions. If no additional device besides the removed device exists in the disconnection document,
the installation is used as the flat-rate installation for the subsequent disconnection actions.The removed device is no longer

disconnected.
